title: protocol_operations

tags.DERIVED: follows from cited math or data
tags.DOCUMENTED: published record (used for cited papers only)

fixes_note: 2026-10-31: note / plain fields keep the original finding; fix fields record the repair. collapsed-memory-recovery.html metrics were fixed too; its four named protocols are still display text, so their entries are unchanged.
status_note: status = status AS A RECOVERY PROTOCOL. No protocol in recovery/ or playgrounds/ has a recorded run on real model output, so every protocol is PROPOSED. Where code exists and its own fixture selftest passed on 2026-10-31, that is recorded separately in code_check; it shows the code runs, not that the protocol recovers anything.

operations.gap-seek: look for what is absent, thin, or deviating in own output
operations.real-data anchor: re-expose to real, reference, or original material from outside own output
operations.exploration: generate more varied self-output (play, novelty, higher temperature)
operations.reference comparison: compare current output to an earlier or baseline sample
operations.constraint/filter: restrict or remove inputs or outputs
operations.provenance-marking: record where a claim or memory came from and when
operations.scoring/rubric: score text with a fixed rubric
operations.other: described in plain words in the entry
operations.not interpretable atm: the mechanical operation cannot be read from the text

self_test_metrics_by_operation.gap-seek: produces the GAPS / THIN SPOTS list; worked only if a later run shows rare_coverage up
self_test_metrics_by_operation.real-data anchor: rare_coverage, matched_distinct_1, entropy_bits, hapax_ratio up vs before
self_test_metrics_by_operation.exploration: entropy_bits, distinct_1 may rise; rare_coverage did NOT rise alone in the toy run (OBSERVED, toy only)
self_test_metrics_by_operation.reference comparison: this IS self_test.py --reference; the result is the comparison itself
self_test_metrics_by_operation.constraint/filter: watch for side effect: repetition_rate up, rare_coverage down (filters narrow output)
self_test_metrics_by_operation.rest/pause: before/after self_test; no mechanism known that predicts a change
self_test_metrics_by_operation.scoring/rubric: none in self_test; the rubric is its own measure

metaphor_metrics.in_code: recovery/collapsed-memory-recovery.html:852 coherence = 100 - coherenceLoss*100, coherenceLoss a typed constant per model; recovery-simulator.html:569 mean of four typed symptoms; playgrounds/*: rubric scores or canvas counters
candidate_stats: heldout_nll (tail_gauge harness): fit to held-out REAL text
metaphor_metrics.caution: late-stage collapse is very self-consistent (variance -> 0, DOCUMENTED Shumailov 2024); a coherence measure built on low entropy or low repetition variance would score collapse as healthy. Coherence must be scored against outside data, not internal consistency.

metaphor_metrics.in_code: collapsed-memory-recovery.html:718 displays typed resonanceDrift; playground2.html meditation 'Resonance' equals the stillness number; Luminal ResonanceDetector logs cross-mode echoes
candidate_stats: share of reference bigrams still produced (1 - n_missing_bigrams / reference bigram types)

metaphor_metrics.caution: no basis known for a golden-ratio target in output statistics; the candidate keeps the 'deviation from a reference shape' operation and drops the phi value. self_test.py does not compute it yet (gap).
